objective: Prepare L1 integration evidence that automatic semantic skeleton completion and deterministic repository grounding work as one implementation route while preserving AgentTeam-as-target review gates.

previous_evidence_summary.m65_grounding: M65 added read-only repo_grounding.v1 summaries and the agentteam grounding command. It intentionally does not execute candidate commands, install dependencies, mutate the repository, or replace per-attempt repo_context.v1.
previous_evidence_summary.m67_dogfood_calibration: The first live Codex authoring calibration timed out after 300.158 seconds with zero taskpack files. The direct artifact-production rerun completed in 283.139 seconds, wrote 5/5 required files, and validated accepted.
previous_evidence_summary.m67_deterministic_skeleton: The deterministic skeleton experiment emits a valid conservative five-file taskpack skeleton with semantic_authoring_required=true, supplied context_refs, conservative write scope, and semantic_slots; it does not infer repository semantics by itself.

roadmap_followup_route_template.route_name: closed-loop semantic skeleton plus repo grounding
inputs: source_report_path or explicit not provided marker
goal_memory_path or explicit not provided marker
steps: Build or read repo_map.v1 for deterministic repository inventory and selected context.
Build repo_grounding.v1 for language, tool, test-entrypoint, and candidate verification-command signals.
Draft a deterministic taskpack skeleton with context_refs carrying the previous evidence, repo context, repo map, selected next_goal, non-goals, deliverables, and verification command.
Auto-materialize the semantic skeleton without operator-authored semantic JSON.

Validate the materialized taskpack and assert AgentTeam-as-target policy keeps allow_merge=false, operator_review_required=true, and source_control_restrictions no_merge/no_push/no_release_activation.
Use the grounding candidate command as evidence for the bounded verification plan, but do not execute merge, push, release activation, or semantic authority edits.

success_metrics_or_no_metric_delta.metric_delta: No source metric delta; this task only adds a structured evidence artifact.

implemented_changes: Added this structured route-integration evidence artifact under implementation_artifacts/reports.
implemented_changes_or_no_safe_change_ra.no_runtime_source_change_rationale: Existing helpers already satisfy the bounded L1 integration proof when run together. Changing runtime source or tests in this task would exceed the evidence-preparation objective and risk drifting into natural-language report formatting, semantic authority edits, or broader release work.
